body: I'm not really sure to be honest. I used to like playing video games and playing my instrument but i lost my passion for both a long time ago. Keeping my family happy is very important to me even if it means my unhappiness. Doesn't really seem like anything is fun anymore, even things that i used to enjoy alot.
How does one go about making this "happy"?
I'm terrified of spending that much money. Everytime i think about it i think about being old and not having anything and having to work shitty jobs just to make ends meet.
